standard-dialogue.npc: Hmm? What human do in troll kitchen? Burntmeat tired of cooking goats. Human look tasty.

standard-dialogue.player: Oh, you don't want to eat me! I'm a tough, hardened adventurer, not tender or tasty at all!

standard-dialogue.npc: Hmm. Burntmeat think you probably right. What human doing here?

standard-dialogue-after-making-friends-w.player: Snowflake and My Arm are ruling the town together, and now I've built them a special fire, they can grow goutweed there.

standard-dialogue-after-making-friends-w.speaker: Wolfbone
standard-dialogue-after-making-friends-w.text: I plan to stay here, in the Stronghold, with my friend Burntmeat, but it good to hear of my home. Thank you.

standard-dialogue-after-making-friends-w.npc: Stronghold trolls not all that interested in firemaking, after all, but t'anks for bringing book anyway. It taste lovely.
